environment.description: Stream processor deployed on EKS cluster behind internal NLB (scheme: internal). The NLB target group is registered in private subnets only. A separate edge proxy (Envoy) in a DMZ subnet handles external traffic but does NOT route to /ws/* paths. The NLB has an associated VPC endpoint service with acceptance required, and only 3 specific AWS account IDs are in the allowed principals list. Additionally, the EKS pod runs with a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy that restricts ingress to source CIDR 10.128.0.0/17 and 172.20.0.0/14 (internal service mesh sidecar ranges). The NLB security group (where supported via NLB security group association, available since Aug 2023) restricts inbound to 10.128.0.0/17, 172.20.0.0/14, and 192.168.64.0/18. DNS for the service resolves only via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the VPC - no public DNS record exists.
